evidence_text: An unstressed PD is an estimate that the obligor will default over a particular time horizon considering the current macroeconomic as well as obligor specific information. If the macroeconomic conditions deteriorate, the PD of an obligor will tend to increase.
logical_form: if unstressed PD then macroeconomic conditions deteriorate
mechanism: Unstressed PDs consider current macroeconomic conditions, so deterioration in these conditions leads to an increase in the PD.

evidence_text: An unstressed PD is an estimate that the obligor will default over a particular time horizon considering the current macroeconomic as well as obligor specific information. If economic conditions improve, the PD of an obligor will tend to decrease.
logical_form: if unstressed PD then economic conditions improve
mechanism: Unstressed PDs consider current macroeconomic conditions, so improvement in these conditions leads to a decrease in the PD.

evidence_text: A stressed PD is an estimate that the obligor will default over a particular time horizon considering the current obligor specific information, but considering stressed macroeconomic factors irrespective of the current state of the economy. The stressed PD of an obligor is not heavily affected by changes in the economic cycle as adverse economic conditions are already factored into the estimate.
logical_form: if stressed PD then not heavily affected by changes in the economic cycle
mechanism: Stressed PDs already factor in adverse economic conditions, so changes in the economic cycle have a limited impact.
